title: Files, Serialization, Threads, and a Tracker
summary: Combine validated models, file errors, serialization boundaries, threads or channels, shared ownership, synchronization, and tests in a persistent tracker.
learningObjectives: Explain and apply Files, Serialization, Threads, and a Tracker
Use compiler, lint, and test evidence to verify behavior
prerequisiteConcepts: Ability to create and save a text file

sections.heading: Core model
sections.content: File operations return `Result` and should add path and operation context while preserving the source error. Deserialized data is untrusted and must pass domain constructors before becoming application state. Threads require transferred values to satisfy lifetime and thread-safety rules; `move` closures transfer captured ownership. Channels support message passing. Shared mutable state commonly uses `Arc<Mutex<T>>`; handle poisoned locks deliberately and keep critical sections short. Join worker threads and propagate failures instead of allowing detached work to outlive the operation.
